progress.scanning: Searching for a connectable Schneider/WSC device
progress.connecting: Connecting to the mirror cabinet before the pairing/learn step
progress.initializing: Applying the observed Schneider session initialization after the physical button confirmation

select_device.title: Select Schneider/WSC device
select_device.description: More than one compatible device was discovered. Select the mirror cabinet you want to add. Home Assistant will connect to it before asking you to press the physical pairing/learn button.

pairing_confirm.title: Connection established — press the pairing/learn button
pairing_confirm.description:
Home Assistant has successfully established a Bluetooth/GATT connection to **{name}**. **Now press the physical pairing/learn button on the light or mirror cabinet.** After pressing the button, choose **Continue**. Home Assistant will then send the application-level initialization observed in the Schneider app capture.

The captured session shows no standard BLE SMP pairing exchange, so the integration does not call Bluetooth `pair()`. The button is treated as a device-side authorization/learn step that occurs only after the connection has been established.

no_devices.title: No Schneider/WSC device found
no_devices.description: Home Assistant could not discover a compatible Schneider/WSC device before the pairing step. Make sure the cabinet is powered and a connectable Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy is online and nearby, then choose **Retry**. Do not press the cabinet's pairing/learn button yet; Home Assistant will ask for it only after a Bluetooth connection succeeds.

connect_failed.title: Could not connect to the mirror cabinet
connect_failed.description: Home Assistant discovered the Schneider/WSC device but could not establish the Bluetooth/GATT connection. Check that the ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy is online and close to the cabinet, then choose **Retry**. Do not press the pairing/learn button yet — the button prompt is shown only after the connection succeeds.

initialize_failed.title: Authorization/initialization did not complete
initialize_failed.description: Home Assistant connected successfully and you confirmed the physical button press, but the observed Schneider initialization could not be completed. Choose **Retry** to establish a fresh Bluetooth connection; Home Assistant will then ask you to press the pairing/learn button again. No configuration entry was saved.

abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device is not supported by this integration.
